The document describes engineering specifications for guided wave radar level instruments used in HTF services.
Two instrument models are specified: LIT 204-05A and LIT 204-05B, each with different service conditions.
Key components include sensors, flanges, seals, and external cables.
The instruments operate at temperatures ranging from 25°F to 122°F and have a pressure rating of 150 lbs.
Calibration is performed using a keypad or HART communicator, with specific ranges provided in the document.
Notes emphasize the importance of providing nameplates and filling out all required fields by vendors.
Transmitter model: FMP54-C2ACCDLBD2AAJ+AAIJPBZ1
Gauge manufacturer: KTEK
Plumb weight P/N: MW0506/B/SS6/B5FEFEB5/WR23/N74/M1GHS/B/VV/DV/S/624
Calibration method: Keypad / HART Communicator
Accuracy: ± 0.1% of calibrated range
Output signal type: Float - Magnetic Coupled
Float size/materials: 6" Stilling Well, 316 SS Graphoil
Instrument range: See Sketch 2
Process conditions include nitrogen gas and heat transfer fluid
